---
title: "Connect"
---

We host a mailing list, **district magnitude (DM)**, at [Groups.io](https://groups.io). Join the DM to receive the latest news about the section and other opportunities for research, workshops, and more.

To join the list, please send an empty message to [district-magnitude+subscribe\@groups.io](mailto:district-magnitude+subscribe@groups.io). You will receive a confirmation email, so please reply with no content.\
\
Members can make a post by emailing it directly to [district-magnitude\@groups.io](mailto:district-magnitude@groups.io). The post will be reviewed and approved before being sent out to all list members.
